title: Ali's Day
text:
Ali wakes up at seven o'clock every morning. He brushes his teeth and eats breakfast with his family. Then he walks to school with his friend Ece. Ali likes to talk on the way.

After school, Ali does his homework at the kitchen table. At six o'clock, he helps his mother cook dinner. He goes to bed at nine o'clock. His day is always busy but happy.

paragraph_translations: Ali her sabah saat yedide uyanır. Dişlerini fırçalar ve ailesiyle birlikte kahvaltı eder. Sonra arkadaşı Ece ile okula yürür. Ali yolda konuşmayı sever.
Okuldan sonra Ali ödevini mutfak masasında yapar. Saat altıda annesinin akşam yemeği pişirmesine yardım eder. Saat dokuzda yatağa gider. Günü her zaman meşgul ama mutlu geçer.
